source.scope: Dockerfile, Compose, Docker ignore, root/toolchain/license/manifests; domain/server/web and scripts including native license assets. Excludes generated distributions, node_modules, test/tests trees; captures mobile manifest only.

appChecks: compiled CLI bootstrap and password recovery
database-backed service health and built web HTML/JavaScript
signed-in private photo and task-file upload/download with no-store
preferences, media, database and owner bootstrap persist across app+database restarts
runtime imports, native sharp encoding/decoding, UID 1000 and writable media
runtime excludes handwritten source, tests and native/development dependencies
operatorChecks: protected coherent backup after write drain
archive 0700 / dump 0600 / configuration and dump checksum
matching migrations, preserved installation identity and rotated epoch
original installation identity/epoch unchanged and original maintenance resumed
finalized and pending private bytes restored

nativeLicenses.externalDistributionGate: Actual upstream post-edit Cargo.lock/toolchain not proven; source provenance/coverage remains a separate gate. Validator is inventory/hash evidence, not legal compliance certification.

npmRegistryAudit.method: POST exact final-image name/version inventory to official https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk
npmRegistryAudit.limitations: Npm package advisory check excludes OS and bundled native-library vulnerability review.

verificationLimits: No personal configuration or WHOOP effect verification
No mobile connectivity/signing or other CPU-architecture claims
No external artifact distribution authorization/compliance claim
